matrices.name: sangok_c04_develop_perforated_base~full_ground^cross_open
matrices.secondary_language: Perforated base beneath a continuous upper body
matrices.formal_principle: Lift a narrow transverse strip of the underside to form a covered ground passage through the central body and rear wall. The continuous upper volume frames the two carved courts while the retained north and south masses remain grounded.
